title: Android Enterprise Enrollment Troubleshooting — Managed Google Play, Web Enrollment & "Can't Add a Google Account" (AMAPI)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft Android implementation).

Intune admin center / Microsoft Graph / managed Google Play / Google Admin console authored at exact detail from Microsoft & Google public docs. The Android Management API (AMAPI) transition, web/account-driven enrollment, and whether a change triggers device RE-ENROLLMENT are actively evolving — cited or flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance / your tenant', never asserted from memory or invented. OEM (Samsung Knox/Zebra) + third-party apps at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (Graph); no hardcoded credentials/secrets. No client names.
hook: Fix Android enrollment failures — especially "can't add a Google account"
problem: Android Enterprise enrollment fails in maddening ways: the device won't add a Google account to Gmail or the device, web / account-driven enrollment works in dev but not prod, or enrollment stalls after an AMAPI migration. This solution is a layered enrollment diagnostic playbook: the managed Google Play binding health, the enrollment-method path, network/endpoint reachability, identity and account-add flow, dev-vs-prod configuration differences, and post-AMAPI-migration issues — a symptom→root-cause tree that gets devices enrolling and accounts adding.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the enrollment moving parts (managed Google Play binding, enrollment method, network endpoints, identity/account add, AMAPI vs legacy) and the diagnostic method.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise, admin roles, a reproducible test device, network visibility).

Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom→root-cause decision tree: can't add a Google account, web/account-driven enrollment works in dev but fails in prod, binding/connector errors, endpoint/proxy blocks, and post-AMAPI-migration failures — with the exact checks and fixes at each node.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (device enrolls, Google account adds, apps deliver) plus Best Practices for reducing enrollment-failure ticket volume; version-specific AMAPI behavior flagged to verify.
short: A layered Android Enterprise enrollment troubleshooting playbook — managed Google Play binding, enrollment-method path, endpoints, the can't-add-a-Google-account failure, dev-vs-prod differences, and post-AMAPI issues — a symptom-to-root-cause tree that gets devices enrolling. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
